import pandas as pd

# File paths for source CSVs
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_91/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_91/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_91/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_91/training_3.csv"
]

# Read all source files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
dfs = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files]

# Extract only the 'attributes' column from each dataframe
attributes_dfs = [df[['attributes']] for df in dfs]

# Concatenate (union) all attributes columns vertically
union_df = pd.concat(attributes_dfs, ignore_index=True)

# The target schema is ['attributes'] and target examples show some non-null values.
# The intermediate_step1.csv after union shows mostly NaN in attributes.
# We keep the union as is, since the operation history is just UNION.

# Save the final target dataframe to the specified path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_91/target_multisource.csv"
union_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
